questions.q: Pipe A can fill a tank in 4 hours, while Pipe B can fill the same tank in 8 hours. Both pipes are opened together for 2 hours, after which Pipe A is closed. Find the additional time taken by Pipe B to fill the remaining part of the tank.
questions.solution: Translate each condition into a short calculation and carry it through; the result is 2 hours. **Answer: 2 hours**
questions.shortcut: Add filling rates, subtract outlet rates.
